board_description.p1: is a personal tool to help you manage your weekly work.
board_description.p2: It's designed for individual use, not for teams. Organize your tasks on a simple board and stay focused on what matters.

home.hero_title: Your week, organized in a single board.
home.hero_subtitle: Tasks, notes, and time tracking in one place, no tab-switching.
home.screenshot_title: This is what your week looks like
home.screenshot_subtitle: The guest board, exactly as you see it: columns, priority, and time tracking.
home.features_title: Everything you need, nothing you don't
home.feature_board_desc: Columns, priority tags, and reminders to organize your week.
home.feature_notes_desc: One long note per board and short notes per task, so you never lose the thread.
home.feature_time_desc: Usage sessions and a 60-day history, exportable to PDF or JSON.
home.feature_account_desc: Guest mode with no sign-up, or up to 5 synced boards with an account.
home.faq_1_q: Do I need to create an account?
home.faq_1_a: No. Guest mode saves everything in your browser and works entirely without signing up. An account adds sync and up to 5 boards.
home.faq_2_a: No, it's built for a single person managing their own work, not for team collaboration.
home.faq_3_q: What happens to tasks I finish?
home.faq_3_a: They're archived daily, with 60 days of capacity, and you can export the whole archive to PDF or JSON.
home.faq_4_a: Yes. Capo is open source under the MIT license.
home.faq_5_a: Without an account, your tasks stay only in your browser. With an account, they're stored on the server, isolated per user — no one else can access your board. More details in
home.footer_tagline: A personal board for your work week.
